request.spec:
A paste box takes lines of name,amount,date,note (the note may hold commas; the date may be
blank for the sheet's today; the note may be absent) and adds a DRAFT claim per line, in order,
for the named person (the name must be on the sheet, matched as names are compared). Every line is
checked first with exactly the claim form's rules: if any line fails, an error shows on the box
and nothing is added; otherwise every claim is added and written as CLAIM_ADDED. Show how many
were added.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A paste box takes lines of name,amount,date,note (the note may hold commas; the date may be
blank for the sheet's today; the note may be absent) and adds a DRAFT claim per line, in order,
for the named person (the name must be on the sheet, matched as names are compared). Every line is
checked first with exactly the claim form's rules: if any line fails, an error shows on the box
and nothing is added; otherwise every claim is added and written as CLAIM_ADDED. Show how many
were added.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The paste box is in, and `bin/e2e` now passes all 4 acceptance tests. The first run failed because the paste form wasn't bound to an Angular form, so pressing submit did a normal browser submit instead of calling the server. I bound it to a form group and the second run passed.

**How it works**
- **Server:** a new `POST /api/sheets/{sheetId}/paste-claims` endpoint (`paste/PasteController.java`, `paste/PasteService.java`).
- **Reading each line:**
  - Each line is split on the first three commas, so any commas after that stay in the note (`a, b`).
  - The name is trimmed and looked up the same way names are matched elsewhere, ignoring case (so ` ADA ` finds Ada).
  - The amount must pass the claim form's amount pattern.
  - A blank date means the sheet's today; a missing note is stored as empty.
- **Checking:**
  - The service reads and checks every line first, then adds each one as a draft through the same code the claim form uses. That code applies the remaining rules: a closed period, a retired person, and a negative amount with no claim to correct.
  - Everything happens in one transaction. If any line fails, nothing is stored and nothing goes to the audit file, because `CLAIM_ADDED` is only written once the transaction is saved.
- **Screen:** the box sits under quick-add in `people.ts`, with `paste-claims`, `paste-submit`, `paste-added` (how many were added) and `paste-error`. The error clears when the text is edited or submitted again. New claims are added to their people's lists newest first.

**Choices the request didn't settle, which you may want to check:**
- Blank lines in the box are skipped, and a box with no lines at all is refused.
- A line with only a name and amount (no date or note) is accepted.
- An unreadable date or a note over 1,000 characters refuses the whole paste with an error naming the line.
